answer: To stem the tide of Sybil swarms, our network requires cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs, linking identity to quadratic staking. Rather than gathering easy nectar through cloned identities, attackers face exponential capital exhaustion where each added agent costs $O(2^n)$ in staked bond. Even a faint whisper of collusion triggers automated slashing across the chain, making mass subversion mathematically ruinous.
